svg.text: Median wall time · logarithmic scale · lower is better
Validated web-codecs profile · 2026-08-24 · linux x64 · v24.16.0
Resize uses engine defaults: PureJsImage and Sharp use Lanczos 3; Jimp uses bilinear. Timings include encoding and are not matched quality across kernels or lossy encoders.

Source: 2026-08-24T20-51-40-120Z-purejsimage-purejsimage-wasm-jimp-sharp-sharp-single-thread-image-js-jsquash-web-codecs.json · Unsupported rows are explicit; only validated outputs contribute performance bars.
